**Devin M. Drown**  
Associate Professor  
Drown Lab, University of Alaska Fairbanks
:::
:::

Ph.D. Biological Sciences, 2010, Washington State University

Devin Drown is an Associate Professor of Biology at the University of Alaska
Fairbanks. His research takes a One Health approach to questions related to
ecosystem change. His group uses emerging next-generation sequencing tools to
explore soil microbial communities of the Subarctic, understand the diversity of
antibiotic resistance in disturbed environments, and detect emerging pathogens.

He led a multi-year project expanding genomic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2 in
Alaska. His research team has a commitment to broadening participation in
biomedical research. He uses nanopore hackathons to enable undergraduates to
analyze next-generation sequence data using bioinformatic pipelines to answer
questions in genomics.
